tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is molcajete basalt, the brand's home; day is cucumber paper for documents and light pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, forms sitting on ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, the stub of a boarding pass, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card edges. Decorative only; a control's border uses line-strong.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, ghost buttons and outlined chips (3:1 or more on ground and surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark, on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: onion
tokens.usage: Red onion, the spark. The one onion wedge of the Slice, the 1 in the wordmark, the primary action, links. As text, on ground, surface and onion-soft.

tokens.name: on-onion
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an onion fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: onion-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind onion text: a selected filter, a highlight.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Lime, the Slice's rind and wedges at night, highlights, the night focus ring. On day it is a fill only, never text; the day Slice is drawn in ink.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text on a lime fill.

tokens.name: cucumber
tokens.usage: Relief blocks and quiet tints (cover, section breaks). Fill only, with on-lime text.

tokens.name: shrimp
tokens.usage: Warm accent, used small: the ticket edge of a code drop, one block on the cover. Text only at night; on day a fill with on-lime text.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: On the App Store. Night: a chip fill with on-live text. Day: chip fill or text on ground and surface. Always with the words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on a live fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 3px from the element, on every surface.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page: the website hero, a deck's title slide. Shrinks to 40px on phones.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Every app we make is its own world.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Apple gives us 100 codes per version, so when they're gone, they're gone.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Requires iOS 17.5 or later · iPhone and iPad

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The label above a section heading, set in capitals, in onion.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Promo codes, versions, bundle ids: anything a person types or reads back character by character.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons, between label and value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The phone gutter; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps in a grid of cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space under a section heading.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, app cards, boarding passes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels: the launch panel, a cover block.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, filters.

tokens.name: glow-onion
tokens.usage: The primary button only.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: App icons floating over the starfield or a planet.
